name: ca-study
description: Evidence-first due diligence for crypto CAs, launchpads, pools, tokenized-stock claims, distributions, and project authenticity.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-first crypto CA and project due diligence
interface.longDescription: Investigates chain identity, launchpad attribution, pools and exact paired assets, official or third-party stock-token provenance, distributions, contract control, website and X authenticity, community quality, and rug indicators. Applies separate application and meme rating frameworks.
defaultPrompt: 分析这个 CA：发射台、主池、配对资产、合约权限、团队与风险。
查币股配对是否官方，分红是否真实，并介绍底层股票。
按应用类或 Meme 类标准评价项目、X 和社区。
